changelog:
threejs-ai-skill v0.1.0

- Initial release introducing guidance and best practices for generating robust, playable Three.js/react-three-fiber scenes with AI-generated code.
- Defines a layered rule set covering core issues: model normalization, camera framing, object placement, collision handling, controls, and animation.
- Supplies a strict pre-flight checklist to ensure scene correctness and prevent common visual/interactive failures.
- Includes version-aware notes for key Three.js API changes to help avoid outdated code patterns.
- Designed to apply automatically to any AI-generated code involving Three.js, react-three-fiber, or WebGL.
summary: Makes AI-generated Three.js / WebGL / react-three-fiber code produce coherent, playable 3D scenes instead of code that compiles but looks and feels broken —...
